Package dayplanner

Class Activity

java.lang.Object
dayplanner.Activity
Direct Known Subclasses:
HomeActivity, OtherActivity, SchoolActivity
public abstract class Activity extends Object
Represents an activity with a title, startingTime, endingTime, and a comment

      public Activity(String title, Time startingTime, Time endingTime, String comment) throws InvalidActivityException, InvalidTimeException
      Creates an activity with the supplied field values.
      Parameters:
      title - The title of the activity
      startingTime - The starting time of the activity
      endingTime - The ending time of the activity
      comment - A short description of the activity
      Throws:
      InvalidActivityException - if a required field is invalid
      InvalidTimeException - if a time field is invalid
